_: Available experiments, costs and settable parameters. Loader must strip any key beginning with underscore.

experiments.name: Thermal shift (DSF), with and without coenzyme A pre-saturation
experiments.question: Does the compound still bind when the enzyme is saturated with its natural substrate?

experiments.name: Co-crystal structure of the inhibitor-enzyme complex
experiments.question: Where and how does the compound bind?
experiments.readout: structure, resolution in angstroms, contact residues

experiments.name: Four-strain MIC panel
experiments.question: Does killing depend on the nominated target?

experiments.name: Potency optimisation across the analogue library
experiments.question: Can the compound be made more potent against the purified enzyme?
experiments.readout: best IC50 achieved across the library, nanomolar; whole-cell MIC50 of the best compounds

experiments.name: Counter-screen against a structurally unrelated enzyme
experiments.question: Do any analogues that kill the bacterium act through the nominated target?
experiments.readout: IC50 at both enzymes plus MIC, per analogue

experiments.name: Intrabacterial pharmacokinetics by LC-MS
experiments.question: How much compound gets inside, and does it survive once there?
experiments.readout: percent of input partitioned into medium / intracellular intact / biotransformed, per compound arm

arms.note: All three arms run together; the assay is not offered for a single compound.
